remarks: Welcome to 168 Belltown Road, Unit 31-an updated, modern end unit townhouse tucked privately at the back of the complex. This spacious stylish home features hardwood floors throughout and a bright, open layout that immediately feels inviting. The expansive living room leads seemlessly into the beautifully updated kitchen which is the heart of the main level; offering quartz countertops, a breakfast bar, and a dedicated dining area. From here, step out onto the private deck overlooking a serene wooded backdrop and an expansive side and backyard: an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining. A beautiful half bath and numerous closets complete this level. A soaring cathedral ceiling within the staircase, paired with a large upper window, floods the home with natural light and adds a dramatic architectural touch. Upstairs, you'll find two generous bedrooms, conveniently located laundry, and a well appointed bathroom. With its modern design, exceptional privacy, and close proximity to NYC as well as Stamford's shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this end unit delivers both style and convenience in a highly desirable location.
